scientific_integrity: The previously known order-two index counts and labeled interval-order totals are not claimed as new. The structural bijection, simplicial marking criterion, sharp shortest length, and length enumerator are the assessed claim. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Full-support words and scattered subwords of length at most two only; finite sum over labeled interval orders, not an asymptotic formula; finite verification through five letters; unindexed equivalent results possible.
title: Interval orders with simplicial point markings classify order-two subsequence spectra
